depiction_rules.notes: A few distinct adult figures gathered around Kamsa. Use varied, restrained mythic features while preserving ordinary attached limbs and readable individual silhouettes.

visual_bible.face: individually varied stern faces; avoid identical repetitions
visual_bible.hair: varied simple dark hair or restrained headwear
visual_bible.clothing: muted maroon, ochre, and dark cream council garments
visual_bible.continuity_markers: clearly a small supporting group, subordinate to Kamsa

never: no accidental duplicate people or fused faces
no horror exaggeration, gloss, or photorealism
note: Provisional minimal group contract for D039 only; no named asura identity is assigned here.
